name: Blackboard
src_typeComment: Shared key-value AI memory: lets independent systems (perception, combat, movement) read/write common facts ("LastKnownPlayerPosition", "IsAlerted", "CurrentTarget") without holding direct references to each other. Deliberately just a plain data store, not tied to any specific AI architecture — a squad of agents can share one Blackboard, or each agent can have its own.  This is intentionally the ONLY piece built from the GOAP discussion: a full Goal-Oriented Action Planner needs concrete, game-specific actions/preconditions/effects to be useful, which makes a truly generic planner thin value on its own — but a planner (or any future, more advanced decision system) would read/write world-state through exactly this kind of generic store, so building Blackboard now means adding one later doesn't require reworking anything here.
